title: The Spire of Caerlum
author: Juniper Dravenmoor
blurb: Xanthe Nystrom, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
